applications.title: Applications
applications.subtitle: Every Django project the manager backs up, and the server it runs on.

list.label: Applications
list.onServerBody: The Django projects this server runs, on the server itself or in containers.
list.name: Name

empty.title: No applications yet
empty.body: Add an application from the page of the server it runs on.
empty.serverTitle: No applications on this server yet
empty.serverBody: Add the Django project this server runs, so the manager can check it and back it up.

noMatch.title: No matching applications
noMatch.body: Try another name, server or host.

check.title: Check
check.wait: A check can take up to a minute.
check.ready: django-dbs here and in the application work together.
check.incompatible: The application's django-dbs is too old for this manager. Upgrade it in the application.
check.panelSchedule: The application's own DBS panel also schedules backups, while the manager takes them too. Turn off the panel's schedule, or plan fewer backups here.

report.timeout: The timeout command inside the container, to stop a command that runs out of time

settings.title: Settings
settings.envInContainer: This .env file is inside the container. A .env file written there is lost when the container is created again, so keep the one the container starts with on the server too.

mounts.title: Mounted folders
mounts.body: Read from the container. Change them in the compose file or where the container is started.

passphrase.title: Backup passphrase
passphrase.body: It encrypts the django-dbs backups of this application. Keep a copy somewhere safe.
passphrase.label: Passphrase
passphrase.neverChange: Never change this passphrase: the backups taken with it would no longer open.
passphrase.readFirst: Read the passphrase from the application now, before its first backup. It must never change afterwards: older backups would no longer open.

prompt.title: Show backup passphrase
prompt.body: Enter your password to show the backup passphrase.

delete.title: Remove application
delete.body: Removes this application from the manager. Its backups on the server stay there.
delete.prompt: {name} is removed from the manager, and its backups on the server stay there. Enter your password to remove it.

password.title: Confirm it is you
password.body: Changing the Python of this application needs your password.

problems.container_not_running: The container is not running, so nothing inside it was read.
problems.dbs_missing: No Python here can import django-dbs.
problems.dbs_too_old: django-dbs here is too old for this manager.
problems.backup_dir_not_mounted: The backup folder is not a mounted folder, so the manager cannot collect the backups.

name.label: Name
name.hint: A name to tell this application apart.

composeService.label: Compose service
composeService.hint: The service in the compose file that runs Django, such as backend.

composeProject.label: Compose project
composeProject.hint: Leave empty to use the folder's name.

composeFiles.label: Compose files
composeFiles.hint: Leave empty to use the folder's own compose file. Add files in the order compose -f takes them, pressing Enter after each one.

containerName.label: Container
containerName.hint: The name or id of the container that runs Django.

hint.compose: The folder on the server that holds the compose file.
hint.container: The application's folder on the server, if it has one.

workdir.label: Folder inside the container
workdir.hint: Where manage.py runs inside the container. Leave empty to use the container's own.

pythonPath.label: Python command
pythonPath.hint: python3, or the Python of the project's virtual environment.
pythonPath.containerHint: The Python inside the container, such as python.

managePath.label: manage.py path
managePath.containerHint: Inside the container, relative to the folder it works in.

settingsModule.label: Settings module
settingsModule.hint: Leave empty to use the project's default.

remoteBackupDir.label: Backup folder
remoteBackupDir.hint: Where backups are written on the server.
remoteBackupDir.containerHint: Where backups are written, as the container sees it. It must be a mounted folder, so the manager can collect them from the server.

envPath.label: .env file
envPath.hint: Full path to the project's .env file, if it has one.
envPath.pickHint: Choose one of the .env files found, or type its full path.

fileRoots.label: Allowed folders
fileRoots.hint: Folders the Files tab can open. Press Enter after each one.
fileRoots.containerHint: Folders the Files tab can open, as the container sees them. Press Enter after each one.

accountPassword.hint: Changing anything but the name needs your password.

folder.intro: Choose the folder of the Django project, or of the compose file that runs it. DBS looks inside it for manage.py and for the containers that use it.
folder.label: Folder on the server
folder.hint: Leave empty to see the project folders found on this server.

discovery.notThere: {folder} is not a folder on this server.
discovery.pickFolder: Choose one of the project folders found on this server, or browse for another.
discovery.noFolders: No project folders were found in the home folder, /srv, /var/www or /opt. Browse the server for the folder.
discovery.untrusted: Other accounts can write to {folder} or to the folder above it, so DBS ran nothing in it. Let only its owner write there, then search again.
discovery.none: No Django project and no container using this folder was found. Continue to fill in the settings yourself, or choose another folder.

review.filled: Filled in from what discovery found. Check each value.

check.later: Open the application and fix it later

passphrase.intro: The backup passphrase can be read from the application's settings. This step is optional.

backup.intro: Take a first backup to confirm everything works.

password.title: Confirm it is you
password.body: This server's setup is over, so searching it needs your password.
password.adding: Adding an application lets the manager run its Python and manage.py on the server, so it needs your password.
password.running: Changing the Python the manager runs on the server needs your password.

title.backups: Choose where backups go on the server

browser.projects: Project folders found on this server
browser.isProject: This folder is a Django project: it holds manage.py.
browser.name: Name
browser.truncated: This folder holds more than 5000 entries. Only the first 5000 are listed.

errors.compose_service_required: Name the Compose service that runs the application.
errors.compose_folder_required: Enter the folder that holds the compose file.
errors.container_required: Name the container that runs the application.
